description: This file defines internal data structures related to arena decay and arena management in jemalloc, including arena decay state, arena structure, thread data, and context structures.

classes.name: arena_decay_s
classes.description: Structure representing decay state for an arena, including mutex, timing, backlog, and stats.

classes.name: arena_s
classes.description: Main structure representing an arena, including thread management, extents, decay states, bins, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: arena_tdata_s
classes.description: Thread-specific data structure for arena decay ticker.

classes.name: alloc_ctx_s
classes.description: Context structure for rtree lookups, including size index and slab flag.
